claims.text: Many reviewers report that the sprayers or nozzles break, jam, or fail, often within a short time.
Several reviewers praise the bottles as pretty, attractive, and nice-looking, especially the colored glass.
Some reviewers find the bottles well made, durable, and good quality for homemade cleaners.
A few reviewers note minor issues like missing caps, scratches on arrival, or tops that unscrew easily.
Some reviewers say the sprayer quality is not as good as other bottles or could be improved.
